title: Word Wizardry: School Writing Bundle (1st to 6th Grade)
heading: Word Wizardry: School Writing Bundle (1st to 6th Grade)

messages: Everything a teacher needs to build stronger writers, in one bundle
Fun, engaging resources for group work and independent learning
Quantities matched to your year groups

description.html:
Give every child in your school the writing skills they'll use for life.

 

The Word Wizardry Writing Toolkit is a complete, ready-made classroom resource that gives teachers everything they need to teach writing — with confidence, structure, and results. No hunting for resources. No time wasted planning from scratch. Just brilliant, curriculum-aligned tools your students will actually enjoy.

Bursting with rich vocabulary, bold illustrations, and engaging activities rooted in the Science of Reading, this bundle is designed so that children don't just learn how to write — they want to write. When kids are entertained, they pay attention. And when they pay attention, they truly learn.

 

What's included (for schools with one class per grade):

  • The Book of Big Feelings ×7 (Kindergarten–Grade 6): Emotionally engaging stories and vocabulary that give children the words to express themselves and fuel their writing
  • Storyteller's Word a Day ×4 (Grades 3–6): Builds rich, expressive vocabulary day by day through this captivating illustrated flipbook
  • Vocabularious ×4 (Grades 3–6): The word-collecting card game that makes vocabulary stick — perfect for independent learning and group work
  • How to Write a Story ×4 (Grades 3–6): A step-by-step guide that gives students the skills, structure, and words to become confident, creative writers

 

Simply add any combination of our products to your order and the discount is applied automatically. If your school is 5FE or more, just add as many smaller bundles as you need (e.g. 2FE & 3FE) or get in touch.
